'''Wamoth'''<ref name="Fascinating Facts">''[[Star Wars: Fascinating Facts]]''</ref> was a [[Tarlafar]]<ref name="TBB">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/identity-crisis-episode-guide|text="Identity Crisis" Episode Guide | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}}</ref> who lived during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Wamoth watched a sabacc match between [[Han Solo]] and [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]]. When Han Solo seemingly won, Wamoth shook hands with him.<ref name="Solo" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Wamoth first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' and was one of several characters played by ''[[Star Wars]]'' veteran [[Warwick Davis]].<ref name="Fascinating Facts" />
